busy.description: A call from the agent is in flight, a delivery hasn't settled, or a stream is open.

quietForMs.description: Milliseconds since the last event in the session. 0 while busy.

open.description: What is still open, in words: deliveries that haven't settled, streams never stopped.

text.description: The transcript as plain text, one entry per line.
